title: Practice named regex groups
description: This harness checks patterns that must provide specified named capture groups.

steps.description: TASKS describes three pattern-writing tasks. Each task gives an input and the group dictionary the completed pattern must produce.
The loop prints each task. A None pattern is unfinished, so the loop reports that state and continues.

steps.question: What does the harness print before any patterns are written?
steps.answer: It prints '(not written yet)' once for each task.

steps.description: A completed pattern is tested with fullmatch against given. The harness reads named groups through groupdict() and compares them with want.
The first unfinished task takes the continue branch.
